factors.proof: For q>=4(A+1), d/dq log[exp(q/2) IG(q;A,B)] = 1/2-(A+1)/q+B/q^2 >=1/4. The integral diverges for every A,B>0.
factors.consequence: M5 true posterior-predictive covariance is not finite already at h=1; finite empirical covariance does not fix the target. h=4 also contains a final SV innovation with this property.
factors.m4_contrast: M4 log variance has a Gaussian prior and no random inverse-gamma log-volatility innovation variance; this divergence argument does not apply to M4.
